_doc: Chép sang ~/.config/mac-selfdefense/config.json rồi sửa. Bỏ trống file này thì dùng mặc định trong selfdefense.mjs.
_notify_doc: auto = thu direct api.telegram.org truoc, that bai thi relay qua SSH toi relayHost bang relayKey.
_hold_doc: hold.json (trong state dir) liet ke cac duong dan phai GIU cach ly; daemon kiem tra lai moi hold.everyMs.
_startup_doc: Theo doi shell rc + crontab + login items. KHONG tu sua file cau hinh shell.
_trustSignatures_doc: Updater/installer hop le hay chay helper tu /tmp — ma vung tam la tin hieu CUNG. Mien tru theo CHU KY SO cua nha phat hanh (khong theo ten file): Microsoft = TeamID UBF8T346G9, Apple = Authority 'Software Signing'. Ma doc tu xung 'Microsoft AutoUpdate' ma khong co chu ky van bi xu ly nhu thuong. Dat trustSignatures=false de tat han mien tru.
_no_prompt_doc: tcc.source='log' va checkLoginItems=false la CO Y: doc TCC.db hay goi osascript deu khien macOS hoi quyen cho binary 'node' (ad-hoc, khong Team ID) => hop thoai hien lai lien tuc. Do that 29/09/2026.
